title: Start here
summary: Configure the live network, learn the Arbitrum-specific execution rules, deploy on testnet, and check service health before debugging application code.

links.description: Official entry point for the permissionless EVM Layer 2, with routes to network, contract, asset, bridge, oracle, and operations documentation.
Copy the official mainnet and testnet chain IDs, public RPCs, explorers, sequencer feeds, and wallet configuration; public endpoints are rate-limited and not for production.
Deploy and verify Solidity contracts with Foundry or Hardhat, using testnet first and Blockscout for source verification.
Request 0.01 testnet ETH and five of each listed Stock Token once every 24 hours. Faucet eligibility and actual claim execution remain untested.
Required reading for Nitro block semantics, fee accounting, address aliasing, finality, transaction ordering and screening, and the 96 KB contract-size limit.
Check mainnet and testnet service health and upgrade notices before treating an RPC, feed, or sequencer issue as an application bug.

title: Verify network activity
summary: Use the explorers linked by the official network guide to inspect transactions, contracts, logs, and verification state.

links.description: Inspect and verify mainnet contracts, transactions, addresses, blocks, and logs on the official Blockscout instance.
Inspect testnet activity and verified contracts; the homepage exposed stale placeholder-looking summary data during review, while its API and the testnet RPC returned current blocks.
